title: Privatisation: telephones, airlines and banks
goal: Read what was privatised in Argentina and Mexico and what defenders and critics said, using the ser passive.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

items: I can say which Argentine and Mexican companies were privatised in the 1990s.
I can give the arguments of the defenders of privatisation.
I can give the arguments of the critics.
I can say what was done and who it was done to with *ser* + participle: *fue privatizada*, *fueron vendidos*.
